player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I repeatedly tried to take the cauldron while holding two other items, ignoring the strict 2-item inventory limit. I also wasted turns trying to take ingredients (water, eye of newt) without first dropping items to make space. My strategy was reactive and disorganized. Next time, I will first read the recipe to identify the exact sequence. Then, I will navigate to the kitchen empty-handed, pick up the cauldron immediately, and only then travel to other rooms to fetch ingredients one by one, dropping them into the cauldron as I go, ensuring I never exceed the inventory limit. I will prioritize the cauldron as the first item in my inventory.
